name: qkd_ahub_sdw-a4-COMMIT
purpose: HKV-AHUB4: harden the KV die static attention hub qkd_ahub_static_dw at the die binding Z_IN_STRIDE 4 (cluster: 4 Z trees + reciprocal leaf + core logic)

bench.name: lint
bench.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN} && printf '%s\n' 'module ot_lint_top; qkd_ahub_static_dw #(.Z_IN_STRIDE(4)) u_top (); endmodule' > {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv && verilator --lint-only -Wno-fatal -Wno-lint -Wno-style -Wno-TIMESCALEMOD -Wno-MULTIDRIVEN -Wno-MODMISSING -DSYNTHESIS --top-module ot_lint_top {RUN}/ot_lint_top.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/qkd_ahub_static_dw.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_static_cal_gen.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkd_ahub_core.sv rtl/hdc/ot_hdc_delay.sv rtl/lib/ot_rst_pipe.sv rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_nhb_tiles_bb.v rtl/hdc/nearhbm/ot_qkh_recip_leaf_bb.v && echo lint-ok

calibrate.reason: ref_tile: boundary referenced in-run to the propagated tree (io_ref_skew.sdc), as the Qwen die masters

route.cmd: export OT_TTB_CORNER_MARK={CL}/ttb_corner.txt && python3 tools/closure_loop/tt_overlay.py {SRC} && export OT_CTS_FIX_HOOKS='physical/common_flow/cg_pushdown.tcl physical/common_flow/clk_net_protect.tcl physical/common_flow/link_budget_hook.tcl'; export OT_ORFS_CORNER_OVERRIDE=TC; HM=0.03 OT_MM_FF_SDC='physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sdw/signoff.sdc' SRC={SRC} OT_PIN_GROUP_MAX=32 bash tools/ref_tile/ref_route.sh physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sdw/kit.env {LABEL} {RUN}/routes

collect.cmd: mkdir -p {RUN}/record/route {RUN}/record/views && cp {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/corner_sta.json {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/status {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/STATUS {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/signoff.sdc {RUN}/record/route/ && python3 tools/ref_tile/ref_tile.py export --orfs-dir {RUN}/routes/{LABEL}/work/orfs --kit physical/ref_tile/qkd_ahub_sdw --out {RUN}/record/views/qkd_ahub_static_dw --macro-view physical/ref_tile/ot_nhb_zh_m5/views/ot_nhb_zh --macro-view physical/ref_tile/qkh_recip_ref/views/ot_qkh_recip_leaf > {RUN}/record/route/export.log 2>&1

budget.reason: ref_tile: boundary budget 0.2 T applied in-run

structural_change: NEW kit (KV-AHUBDW 10-18): the KV die hub element qkd_ahub_static_dw (static six-root hub) as a cluster of 5 CLOSED children (4 ot_nhb_zh m5 views, ot_qkh_recip_leaf np1 view) + flat core / io logic; the closed qkd_ahub_core belongs to the legacy hub and is not used.  RTL pin rules in 02f980add (flop-first pins, ot_rst_pipe regional resets). || KV-AHUBDW2 10-18 (a1 EARLY_FAIL_SETUP -412 ps, classified: core logic depth + cross-cluster wire, NOT child insertion -- macro class +178 ps, spine leaf spread 29 ps): (1) u_io export decided one edge ahead (em_q from latched tgt_q; was cal_r_q -> PV_START+R adder -> compare -> 145 W-face enables, 289 endpoints); (2) qkd_ahub_static_core_la: every calendar decode registered one edge ahead (u_dn) with an edge-age-1 decode for the first cycle (u_d1), nblk(T) registered from the held command T (u_io T_p/T_h) (age -> rz/rc_x/zh_p/zh_iv/ma_x, T -> hh_b/k_b/z_b); (3) zh_err registered at the Z tree outputs (child zerr -> fault -273 ps); (4) am valid without the u_io.start term (start -> E-face am flops -109 ps; a start on an am edge now faults). || HKV-AHUB4 10-19 (a4): hardened at the KV DIE binding Z_IN_STRIDE = 4 (kv_static_die ASTK_Z_STRIDE = the CLOSED qkd_astk_ctl_s Z stride; claude/hkv-die-1019 e070e47a2 binds ONLY this parameter, AP_OFS / FR_OFS stay RTL defaults). The a3 kit (qkd_ahub_sdw-a3-dad8bea8e) is the RTL default stride 16 = a reference, NOT the die binding. RTL byte-identical to a3 (04e81f626): at stride 4 the Z window divide / modulo are 2-bit shifts / masks (the guard Z_IN_STRIDE < 4 passes; slot_h = d[1:0], slot_k = d[5:2], k <= 15 since nblk <= 16).
